proof.claim: On the currently tested 64-bit OCaml hosts, every signed 32-bit Haxe Int value fits exactly in OCaml int. This proves storage and pass-through only: overflow-sensitive and bit-pattern-sensitive operations still require HxInt, and this proof does not admit a 32-bit OCaml target.
